falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because August 2024's actual low was 4,119; breaking 4,150 would indicate a much deeper drawdown than the reference pattern, proving this is not a similar bottom formation but rather a breakdown into a more severe correction

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and systemic stress that contradicts the 'bottom' signal, as August 2024's VIX peak was 28.5 and never exceeded 30 during its bottoming process

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by more than 25 basis points from current level (e.g., from -15bps to -40bps)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A deepening inversion signals accelerating recession risk and credit stress that would override the pattern match; the August 2024 bottom coincided with curve steepening (dis-inversion), so further inversion proves this macro environment is fundamentally different and more dangerous

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
